summary: This bill bars federal funds from going to any state or local government that prohibits residents from owning dogs.

This is a direct mechanism to reduce federal spending by imposing a funding prohibition tied to a policy condition. While the practical impact depends on how many jurisdictions are affected, the core provision is a spending restriction.
